description: This source file defines the enum 'OpenClawCanvasA2UIJSONL' which provides functions to parse, validate, and encode JSON Lines messages related to A2UI protocol messages in the context of the OpenClaw project. It includes a nested struct 'ParsedItem' for representing parsed JSON objects with line numbers. The functions facilitate processing of JSONL data streams, ensuring messages conform to version 0.8 specifications.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIJSONL
classes.description: An enum encapsulating functions to parse, validate, and encode A2UI JSONL messages.

classes.name: ParsedItem
classes.description: A struct representing a line from JSONL along with its line number, holding the decoded message.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSONL string into an array of ParsedItem objects containing line numbers and decoded messages.

methods.name: validateV0_8
methods.description: Validates a set of ParsedItem objects to ensure they conform to A2UI v0.8 protocol, checking for allowed message types and version compliance.

methods.name: decodeMessagesFromJSONL
methods.description: Parses and validates JSONL text, returning an array of message objects if successful.

methods.name: encodeMessagesJSONArray
methods.description: Encodes an array of messages into a JSON array string.
